CustomField.description:
IF( OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RNEW - Renewal"), ApplicationReceivedDate__c <= LicenseType__r.EndofRenewalPeriod__c),
AND(
ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RSTR - Restore - No A/I Status"), ApplicationReceivedDate__c <= LicenseType__r.PreviousRestorationDeadline__c),
AND(
ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RSTRA - Restore Active"), ApplicationReceivedDate__c <= LicenseType__r.PreviousRestorationDeadline__c)
),
True,False )
CustomField.label: Is in Current Renewal Period
